# `layout.place_assembly`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.place_assembly.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.place_assembly` (`PlaceAssembly`, WP-S4.02 D6, FR-LAY-061): places the unplaced members of an assembly on a
rail in their member order (`member_order`, the order EW-LAY-016 checks), in one step.

The assembly of `device` is the device itself when it has children, else its parent's. The members placed are those
of `member_order` that are mountable (`mountable(dev)`, D8) and have no placement anywhere; each records its
primary part, turned 0°, and must fit the rail's profile (an unfit member refuses the whole command with
`layout.place`'s text). When no member is on the rail yet, the members go as one block at their minimum gaps
whose left edge is `s`, resolved in `mode` (`free` by default, or `push`) as one item. When some members are on the
rail, `s` and `mode` are not used: each new member is pushed in after its predecessor (the nearest earlier member on
the rail, a member placed by this command included), or before its first placed successor when it has no
predecessor; every pushed neighbour is written in the same step.

Rejected: a device or carrier that does not exist (`/device`, `/carrier`); a duct or a surface ("An assembly is
placed on a rail."); `mode: swap`; a device without an assembly; nothing to place; `s` missing when no member is on
the rail (`/s`); an unfit member; D5's refusals of the mode. Interactive; `Bulk` when it places more than 200.
Outcome: the first new placement.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `device` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A device of the assembly: its root or a member. |

## Types

### CmdNm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### PlaceMode

How `layout.place` and `layout.move` resolve their position on a rail (WP-S4.02 D4, D5). Without a mode the pose
is taken exactly as given.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"free"` | The placement stays where it fits with its minimum gaps, else goes to the nearest position where it fits; nothing else moves. On a surface: the explicit pose. |
| `"push"` | The placement is inserted; the placements to its right move right as far as their minimum gaps require. |
| `"swap"` | The placement exchanges places with the placement under its centre on the same rail. |

### PlaceOnParam

What a placement sits on (D3): `{"carrier": id}` (a rail) or `{"surface": id}` (the plate itself).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A rail (a duct carries no placements).

   Shape: object { `carrier`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `carrier` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2). |

2. **Form 2**: The mounting surface itself.

   Shape: object { `surface`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `surface` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2). |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
